decision.rationale: Wide partitions fail the frozen requirement for a material exact-work gain over k16 at every matched q. k16 q32/O4 already has a sealed two-context capacity fit and is a lower-risk target for the missing finite-queue executable scheduler.

findings.title: Original M361r4 contract did not freeze the M339 2.04394x comparator
findings.detail: M372 separately freezes M339 and redivides 67844260/33192878=2.043940269355372.

findings.title: Independent recomputation starts from frozen M361r4 catalog records
findings.detail: M372 aggregates every partition observation and rechecks nesting, arithmetic and capacity, but does not independently refit all centers from raw M73/M248 traces.

findings.title: Closing wide partitions is prioritization, not cycle/area dominance
findings.detail: Lower exact work outweighs the possible partition-count/table-capacity benefit for the current mainline, but no resource-matched cycle, area or energy implementation proves permanent dominance.

findings.title: k16 q32/O4 remains an implementation target
findings.detail: The two-context capacity fit is sealed, but the finite-queue executable scheduler and RTL/cycle match are still absent.
